notes.title: VER.1.0.5 Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Improve customer inconvenience[/b]

[b]There was an opinion that the UI was complicated, so we simplified it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/3ba6624f36da0885594f149c1fd0c212ffc37feb.png[/img]

1. The button for selecting adult scenes has been simplified.
2. Camera Set button has been simplified.
3. In the easy state, clicking on the UI moves the camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/f0afa00f2fb90d5f0f8a684d612338567623ca61.png[/img]

4. In the expert state, use the mouse to move the camera (press F1 to check the information)

- There are different demands between beginners and experts.
It's hard to balance either side
